aiResearchSummary.text: Humane Genomics is engaged in developing modular viral genomes, as described in Modular viral genomes and methods of producing the same, which details the assembly of viral genomes from multiple DNA fragments with viral adaptor regions. Additionally, Covid19 vaccines and related methods outlines the creation and application of viral vaccine compositions for treating COVID-19. These activities highlight research and development in artificial virus construction and therapeutic vaccine design.
